seo.title: Destinations — Invenio Homes
seo.description: Ibiza, Formentera, Mykonos and Bali. Four islands, one standard — with local teams, licensed houses and the knowledge that only comes from being there.

hero.title: Four islands. *One standard*.
hero.lede: We only work where we can be on the ground. That means local teams, houses we know by heart, and advice that does not come from a search engine.
hero.imageAlt: A temple on the water in Bali at sunset

intro.title: A destination earns its place.
intro.body: A place has to offer more than a beach and an airport. We look for a genuine sense of place, a team we trust and houses that are worth the journey — then we spend a season learning the details before we list a single property.
